advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Move the central mount gate after help/unknown-subcommand interception (or exclude help/--help forms) so a help request never triggers a store mount.
evidence: src/rebar/_cli/__init__.py:406: `    if argv and argv[0] not in _NO_AUTO_MOUNT:`

Help interception happens far later — src/rebar/_cli/__init__.py:540-551 (`if first in ('help', '--help', '-h')` and `if rest and rest[0] in ('--help', '-h'): return _emit_subcommand_help(sub)`), and unknown-subcommand at 554.
main() docstring pledge — src/rebar/_cli/__init__.py:348: `order so no command is executed on a help request and the streams/exit codes`
ensure_store_mounted_best_effort mounts via init_core when attachable — src/rebar/_cli/_init.py:237-240
advisory.finding: The central mount gate runs before help interception and the unknown-subcommand check, so a pure help request (`rebar <cmd> --help`, `rebar --help`, or even `rebar <bogus> --help`) now triggers an actual store mount side effect (symlink creation / branch attach via init_core) in any repo with an attachable store — violating the documented 'no command is executed on a help request' contract.
advisory.suggested_fix: Gate the mount on `argv and argv[0] not in _NO_AUTO_MOUNT and argv[0] not in ('help','--help','-h') and (len(argv) < 2 or argv[1] not in ('--help','-h'))`, or relocate the call below the help/unknown-subcommand interception blocks.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Confirm the added git-subprocess cost of the mount gate on store-free commands (config/explain/audit/help) is acceptable, or skip the gate for commands that never touch the store.
evidence: pending_init_is_symlink shells git — src/rebar/_commands/init.py:622: `    if not os.path.isfile(os.path.join(repo, ".git")):` and _main_worktree_tracker uses git worktree list

pending_init_attaches_to_existing shells git twice — src/rebar/_commands/init.py:646-648: `return _git_ok(repo, "rev-parse", "--verify", branch) or _git_ok(repo, "rev-parse", "--verify", f"{remote_name}/{branch}")`
config intercept documented store-free — src/rebar/_cli/__init__.py:527: `# reconcile/review). No store init: it reads working-tree config files only.`
advisory.finding: The mount gate now runs for store-less intercepts (config, explain, audit, workflow, etc.) which previously performed no store init; when no tracker is mounted it invokes pending_init_is_symlink and pending_init_attaches_to_existing, each spawning git subprocesses, adding latency to every previously store-free invocation.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a test that exercises the symlink-worktree auto-attach branch (a linked git worktree of an initialized main repo) so `pending_init_is_symlink`-driven mounting is covered, not only the origin-tickets branch.
evidence: Source gates the mount on two ORed discriminators: `if _init_cmd.pending_init_is_symlink(root) or _init_cmd.pending_init_attaches_to_existing(root):` (_init.py:237-239)
Docstring names the symlink case first: 'a worktree symlink to an already-initialized main repo, or attaching to an existing local/origin ``tickets`` branch' (_init.py:205-208)

Both mount tests use the `clone_with_origin_tickets` fixture which seeds an origin `tickets` branch and a plain clone (not a linked worktree), exercising only `pending_init_attaches_to_existing` — no test creates a linked git worktree (`.git` as a file) pointing at an initialized main repo (test file lines 35-102)
Docstring: 'It NEVER raises: the whole resolve+attach is swallowed so a no-store command run outside any repo is unaffected.' (_init.py:214-215)
Code: `root = os.environ.get("REBAR_ROOT") or _git_toplevel(); if not root: return` (_init.py:228-230) and `except (Exception, SystemExit) as exc:` (_init.py:241)

test_no_store_command_is_not_force_mounted builds a real git repo (`_git("init"...)`) and sets REBAR_ROOT to it (test lines 109-118), so `root` is always truthy and the no-repo / exception-swallow branches never run
advisory.finding: The symlink-worktree auto-attach branch (pending_init_is_symlink) — the first of the two documented auto-attachable mount cases — is never exercised by any test; both 'auto-mount' tests only drive the pending_init_attaches_to_existing (origin/tickets) branch, so a regression that broke the linked-worktree symlink mount would not be caught.
merged_from: The 'NEVER raises' contract — specifically that a no-store command run OUTSIDE any git repo returns cleanly (no root → early return, and the blanket except swallowing SystemExit/Exception) — is untested; the explain guard test runs inside an initialized greenfield git repo, so neither the `if not root: return` path nor the exception-swallow at line 241 is exercised.
scenarios: A fresh linked worktree of an already-initialized main repo runs verify-commit-ticket; if the symlink discriminator regresses, the store no longer mounts and the intercept dies 'ticket store not found' — exactly bug ad9f, uncaught by CI.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a test asserting ensure_store_mounted_best_effort no-ops (mounts nothing in cwd) when REBAR_TRACKER_DIR is set to an injected tracker.
evidence: Code: `if config.tracker_dir_override(): return` (_init.py:221-222) with comment 'Explicit tracker injected → ... do not auto-mount the cwd repo's tracker.'
Docstring lists '(already a no-op under ``REBAR_TRACKER_DIR`` override ...)' as part of the contract (test file lines 8-9)
Both helpers call `monkeypatch.delenv("REBAR_TRACKER_DIR", raising=False)` (test lines 67, 117), so no test sets the override to verify the gate no-ops under it
advisory.finding: The REBAR_TRACKER_DIR override no-op branch (an injected tracker means the gate must not auto-mount the cwd repo's tracker) is asserted in the docstring but has no test — every mount test explicitly deletes REBAR_TRACKER_DIR, so the override early-return at line 221 is never taken.
scenarios: An embedder/test injects REBAR_TRACKER_DIR while a store also happens to be attachable in cwd; if the override guard regressed, the gate would wrongly mount the cwd repo's tracker, breaking the injected-tracker isolation contract.
